terms.title: Terms of Use, Privacy & General Provisions
terms.commitment_description: Your financial data is protected using strong security controls. Alpha does not sell or share your private data with third parties for marketing purposes.
terms.introduction_body: Alpha is an independent technical system designed to support financial awareness and professional empowerment through smart analytical tools. These terms govern the relationship between Alpha and its users, define the rights and obligations of both parties, and are interpreted in accordance with the laws and regulations in force in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and relevant international standards for data protection and digital innovation.
terms.service_body:
Technical Advisory Services: Alpha provides financial insights and analyses based on data entered by the user. Alpha is not a financial intermediary, a licensed investment advisor, or a payment platform.

Decision Autonomy: Alpha's analytical outputs are non-binding technical guidance. The user remains solely and finally responsible for all financial decisions.
terms.privacy_body:
Encryption and Privacy: Sensitive financial data is protected using appropriate encryption and security measures.

Metadata: Alpha may process usage patterns and technical metadata solely for security, performance, and compliance purposes without compromising the content of protected financial data.

Non-Disclosure: Alpha does not sell or share users' private data with third parties for marketing purposes.

Exclusive Responsibility: The user is solely responsible for the accuracy, adequacy, and completeness of the information they enter. Alpha processes submitted data as provided and is not required to independently verify its financial context or accuracy.

Disclaimer: Alpha is not responsible for losses or damages resulting from inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading information entered by the user.
terms.property_body:
Intellectual Property: All system components, including algorithms, code, interfaces, and designs, are the exclusive property of Alpha or its licensors. Copying, reverse engineering, tampering, or unauthorized use is prohibited.

Legal Compliance: Users must use Alpha in accordance with applicable laws. Users bear full responsibility for unlawful activity, including fraud, money laundering, or terrorist financing. Alpha may report suspected violations to competent authorities where legally required.
terms.disclaimer_body:

Indemnification: The user agrees to indemnify Alpha against legal claims, losses, or expenses arising from misuse of the system or breach of these terms.
terms.account_body:
Data Updates: Users are responsible for keeping their contact and account information current. Alpha is not responsible for notices that are not received because of outdated or incorrect information.

Withdrawal: Where applicable, users may terminate paid services after settling outstanding obligations and providing any legally required notice.

Continuing Obligations: Account termination does not remove legal responsibility for actions taken before termination.

Price Changes: Alpha may adjust fees where permitted by law after providing prior notice. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance, while the user retains the right to stop using the service before the change takes effect.
terms.disputes_body:
Transparency: Where an account is suspended, Alpha may provide a technical explanation and an appropriate grievance channel.

Resolution: Disputes should first be addressed through amicable mediation and may then proceed to independent technical arbitration where applicable.

Jurisdiction: The courts of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan have jurisdiction over disputes involving Alpha, subject to applicable laws.
terms.audit_body: Alpha may maintain a protected technical audit trail for interactive operations and system activities. The audit trail is used to verify system integrity, security, and compliance and is not intended to expose protected financial content. It may be made available to competent authorities when legally required.
terms.kyc_body: If Alpha later connects to financial wallets or processes highly sensitive financial data, it may apply legally approved Know Your Customer procedures. Users may be required to provide documents needed to verify identity and comply with anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing requirements before accessing advanced services.
terms.dpia_body: Alpha follows a privacy-by-design approach and may maintain an internal Data Protection Impact Assessment documenting cybersecurity and financial risks, safeguards, and mitigation measures. This assessment supports technical audits, compliance activities, and the protection of user rights.
terms.development_body: Alpha may periodically update its algorithms, security controls, interfaces, and operating methods to maintain performance and comply with evolving technical and regulatory standards. Continued use of the system after an update becomes effective constitutes acceptance of the updated technical specifications.
terms.acceptance_body: Using Alpha constitutes explicit acceptance of these terms. Alpha may update the terms periodically and will provide notice when required by applicable law. Users should review this page from time to time to remain informed of changes.
